sloka: वरं लब्ध्वा तु ते सर्वे राम रात्रिञ्चरास्तदा ।सुरासुरान्प्रबाधन्ते वरदानसुनिर्भयाः ।। ७.५.१७ ॥
transliteration: varaṁ labdhvā tu te sarve rāma rātriñcarāstadā ।surāsurānprabādhante varadānasunirbhayāḥ ।। 7.5.17 ॥

translations.english: O Rama, having obtained the boon, all those night-wanderers then became very fearless due to the boon and began to harass both gods and asuras.
